evidence_cards.content: At any point in an opening sequence, the sequence shall be halted if: A device fails to report completion of the current sequence step within the response time window allotted for the step; The status of a closure device for the opposite direction of travel changes to 'unknown' or 'open'; or The status of a closure device, which was previously opened at the current entrance, changes to 'unknown' or 'closed'.

source_locations.location: paragraph following item 6 (CMS), under the heading 'At any point in an opening sequence...'

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines explicit exception triggers and system responses (halting the sequence) during operational sequences. While not directly about alarm acknowledgment, it provides concrete evidence of how the system handles exceptions (device failure, status change) by halting operations — which is analogous to exception flow behavior required for the 'Acknowledge Device Alarm' use case when acknowledgment fails or conditions change unexpectedly.
